initiative.title: Speech to text as a Psionic primitive
initiative.body: Whisper (MIT) in Psionic, read from whisper.cpp's ggml files so whisper.cpp is an exact oracle on the same bytes. One primitive for `openagents transcribe FILE` and for in-game voice in the Verse. CPU first, then Metal. Until it runs end to end, the CLI uses a labelled interim whisper.cpp backend. Epic: GitHub #12614.

milestones.title: Whisper runs in Psionic and matches whisper.cpp
milestones.body: Decode, log-mel, weights, encoder, decoder and search, timestamps, and the parity tests that prove each step against whisper.cpp.

milestones.title: One primitive in the CLI and the engine
milestones.body: In-game voice through the voice host, and `openagents transcribe` on Psionic with the interim whisper.cpp backend removed.

tasks.title: Parity harness against whisper.cpp: oracle, fixtures, WER and speed
tasks.body: GitHub #12621. `psionic/tests/whisper_oracle.c` (Firm reason 3) links Homebrew's libwhisper 1.9.2: `mel` (our mel through whisper_set_mel against whisper_pcm_to_mel), `logits` (first-token logits via whisper_get_logits), `tokens` (greedy ids), `transcript`. Fixtures in `psionic/fixtures/whisper/`: whisper.cpp's public-domain jfk.wav and macOS `say` clips of a fixed script naming Psionic, Coax, Verse and Aethyr, each with reference text. A Coax WER tool (word edit distance after lowercasing and removing punctuation). Timings for mel, encode, decode and total on the CPU with 8 threads.
acceptance: psionic/tests/check_whisper.sh prints, for each model, the WER and the time of Psionic and of whisper.cpp.
Psionic's WER is no more than 0.5 points above whisper.cpp's at the same size, and greedy tokens are identical on the fixture set.

tasks.title: Audio decode in Coax: a WAV reader and a 16 kHz resampler
tasks.body: GitHub #12615. `psionic/lib/whisper/wav.coax`: RIFF/WAVE PCM 16, float 32 and extensible, 1 to 8 channels averaged to mono, a typed refusal for each malformed chunk. A band-limited resampler from 8 to 48 kHz down to 16 kHz, shared with verse/voice.coax's. The CLI skips ffmpeg for WAV; ffmpeg stays only for compressed containers (Firm reason 6).
acceptance: coax/bin/coax test psionic/lib/whisper/wav.coax --library passes, with every format and every truncation.
For jfk.wav and a 44.1 kHz say clip, our 16 kHz samples are within 1e-4 RMS of ffmpeg's -ar 16000 -ac 1 -f f32le.

tasks.title: Whisper's log-mel front end matches whisper.cpp
tasks.body: GitHub #12616. `psionic/lib/whisper/front.coax` exists with hand checks. Compare our Slaney filters with the f32 filters in the model file; feed our mel to whisper.cpp through whisper_set_mel and compare its greedy tokens with its own mel's; check the two-pass maximum against the whole-file mel at every 30 s window start.
acceptance: psionic-whisper filters ~/.cache/openagents/models/whisper/ggml-tiny.en.bin reports a maximum difference of at most 1e-7.
psionic/tests/whisper_oracle.c mel reports identical tokens on every fixture for tiny.en and base.en.

tasks.title: Load Whisper ggml weights: names, shapes, f16, then q8_0 and q5
tasks.body: GitHub #12617. `psionic/lib/whisper/ggml.coax` reads the file from a mapped view. Name every tensor the encoder and decoder need and check its shape against the hyperparameters before any compute. Exact f16 to f32 rows. Then q8_0 and q5 rows.
acceptance: psionic-whisper info MODEL prints hyperparameters and tensor counts for tiny.en, base.en, small and large-v3-turbo, and checks the pinned SHA-256 of tiny.en and base.en.
The f16 decoder is checked on all 65,536 bit patterns.

tasks.title: Whisper encoder on the CPU with host threads
tasks.body: GitHub #12618. `psionic/lib/whisper/encoder.coax`: two width-3 convolutions (the second stride 2), exact erf GELU, stored sinusoidal positions, pre-norm blocks (LayerNorm 1e-5, attention with biases on query, value and output, the 4d MLP), the final LayerNorm, and a shortened audio_ctx. The host's threads call exported row-range procedures; output does not depend on the worker count (chapter 35).
acceptance: On jfk.wav with tiny.en and base.en, first-token logits through the oracle decoder are within 1e-2 of whisper.cpp's.
The base.en encoder runs within 2x of whisper.cpp -ng encode time on the M5 Max with 8 threads (370 ms per 30 s window).

tasks.title: Whisper decoder, logit rules, greedy and beam search
tasks.body: GitHub #12619. `decoder.coax`: embeddings and learned positions, causal self-attention with a key and value cache, cross-attention computed once per window, the MLP, logits through the embedding. `search.coax`: whisper.cpp's logit rules (suppress blank and non-speech at the start, paired and non-decreasing timestamps, initial timestamp at most 1.0 s, forced timestamp when their total probability wins), greedy, then beam size 5 and the temperature fallback, and language detection.
acceptance: Greedy tokens are identical to whisper.cpp -bs 1 -bo 1 on every fixture for tiny.en, base.en and base.
Beam-search transcripts are identical to whisper.cpp's defaults on the fixture set.

tasks.title: Timestamps, seek over long files, and SRT
tasks.body: GitHub #12620. Tokens to segments at (t - beg) * 20 ms plus the window offset; seek to the last complete timestamp; files longer than 30 s with the previous text as the prompt; optional --max-len splitting. segments.coax already writes text, SRT, WebVTT and JSON.
acceptance: On a 3-minute fixture, segment boundaries are within 20 ms of whisper.cpp's greedy run.
coax/bin/coax test psionic/lib/whisper/tokens.coax --library covers seek and window offsets.

tasks.title: In-game voice on Psionic: PROVIDER_PSIONIC and an Aethyr procedure
tasks.body: GitHub #12622. Add PROVIDER_PSIONIC to verse/voice-host/speech.c. speech_recognize hands the ended turn's 16 kHz s16 audio to psionic_whisper_pcm16, with the model mapped once at startup. A turn is one window with a shortened audio_ctx. Aethyr programs see a Coax procedure, never the C host. Google and PROVIDER_LOCAL stay available.
acceptance: A voice-host smoke plays a say fixture with PROVIDER_PSIONIC and asserts the transcript.
A 5 s turn with base.en on the CPU is transcribed in under 300 ms, from the turn log.

tasks.title: openagents transcribe on Psionic; remove the whisper.cpp backend
tasks.body: GitHub #12623. Add --backend psionic (psionic-whisper built from the checkout, the same cached ggml file). When the parity task's acceptance holds, make it the default and delete the whisper.cpp backend, its line parser and the whisper-cli lookup in the same change. Read WAV directly.
acceptance: openagents transcribe psionic/fixtures/whisper/jfk.wav --json prints "backend":"psionic" and the reference text.
